text:
molly: heads up — deploy-bot flagged the eu-west canary for payments-service. preupgrade Job keeps failing with `serviceaccount "payments-migrate" not found`. Canary reached 3/3 failures, deploy-bot paused promotion. https://deploy-bot.local/logs/2945002500 :eyes:

sasha: ack, i'm looking. that serviceaccount was removed in chart 3.4.2 when we consolidated SA names. did we forget the migration job to use the new name?

ryan: we intentionally renamed but forgot to update the preupgrade job template in `templates/jobs/preupgrade.yaml`. quick option: rollback to chart 3.4.1 or patch the job to point to `payments-sa` and re-run canary.

nina: rollback will be fastest to restore traffic confidence. ops will need release notes updated — call it 'restore payments: rollback preupgrade hook incompatibility'. change window open now? we have 30m.

molly: deploy-bot suggests `helm rollback` is available. if we do manual patch, we can hotpatch chart in repo and promote. which do folks prefer?

ryan: i'll prepare rollback command and a short patch. rollback command:
```
helm -n payments history payments-service
helm -n payments rollback payments-service 3 --wait --timeout 300s
```

sasha: +1 to rollback now. ryan, file the patch PR and include in release notes. add this to rollback notes: `preupgrade job SA name mismatch introduced in chart 3.4.2`.

nina: i'll update release-notes draft and set a postmortem checklist entry: validate hook templates against SA renames.

deploy-bot: ACTION: canary promotion paused for payments-service (chart: 3.4.2). Suggested action: manual rollback to previous revision or apply hotpatch. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/helm-hooks

molly: ok rolling back in 2 mins, tagging release notes, will ping when done :white_check_mark:

ryan: rollback started — helm client output shows STATUS: deployed, REVISION: 3

molly: confirmed traffic stable. moving to draft release notes and scheduling a follow-up in #postmortems tomorrow 10:00 UTC.

nina: thanks team. add `migration-hook` unit test to chart CI to prevent regressions :memo:

sasha: noted. closing thread once PR lands.
